generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately and in sufficient detail in Section 3: Form of Tender and Qualification information.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
List of Financial Resources with Certificates
List of existing commitments and ongoing works

The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of works usually 80% of the annual requirement of RCC NP3 Class pipes 300mm dia and above- 495 Rmt, Glazed Stone ware pipes of 230mm dia and above-699 Rmt . MH-1.2m dia 1m depth-40 Nos, 1.2m dia 2m depth-2 Nos.
Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works should have Civil contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc
Qualification Information of clause 1.3(A) &(B) are mandatory.

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant)..i.e.,Rs.86.08 Lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the respective works. i.e.,Rs. 43.08 Lakhs.
Assessed available tender capacity is ( AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than Rs.86.08 Lakhs

The successful bidder would be required to give performance bank guarantee of 5% the contract amount plus additional security for unbalanced bid amount from Nationalized / Scheduled Indian Bank, with jurisdiction at Bangalore as specified towards guarantee for completion of work within the stipulated period.
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities usually 30% of the amount of contract i.e., Rs. 25.82 Lakhs.
Profit & Loss Statement certified by Chartered accountant for a minimum period of Two Years should be uploaded in Kppp portal

Providing, lowering, laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of Glazed Stone Ware Pipes of following dia, conforming to IS 651:1992, IS 4127 with latest amendments, including conveying to work site, caulking with hemp dipped in tar and jointing with CM 1:1.5 using OPC, perfect linking and curing for 10 days and testing with water etc. with all lead, lifts and as per Technical Specifications. The cost to include the cost of all jointing materials, necessary survey works for laying of sewer lines etc. complete. The contractor will make own arrangements for procuring water for testing.
